description: This file defines input handling classes for Firefox in the Playwright core project, including implementations for keyboard, mouse, and touchscreen input events, and functions for mapping modifiers and mouse buttons.

classes.name: RawKeyboardImpl
classes.description: Implements keyboard input methods for Firefox, including keydown, keyup, and text input.

classes.name: RawMouseImpl
classes.description: Implements mouse input methods for Firefox, including move, down, up, wheel events, and maintains reference to the page.

classes.name: RawTouchscreenImpl
classes.description: Implements touchscreen tap input for Firefox.

methods.name: function toModifiersMask(modifiers: Set<types.KeyboardModifier>): number { toModifiersMask
methods.description: Converts a set of keyboard modifiers into a bitmask.

methods.name: function toButtonNumber(button: types.MouseButton): number { toButtonNumber
methods.description: Maps mouse button string to numerical identifier.

methods.name: function toButtonsMask(buttons: Set<types.MouseButton>): number { toButtonsMask
methods.description: Converts a set of mouse buttons into a bitmask.

methods.name: keydown
methods.description: Handles key down event, dispatching it to the session.

methods.name: keyup
methods.description: Handles key up event, dispatching it to the session.

methods.name: sendText
methods.description: Sends text input to the page.

methods.name: move
methods.description: Moves the mouse to specific coordinates.

methods.name: down
methods.description: Handles mouse button down at specified position.

methods.name: up
methods.description: Handles mouse button up at specified position.

methods.name: wheel
methods.description: Dispatches a wheel event for scrolling.

methods.name: setPage
methods.description: Associates a page object with the mouse handler.

methods.name: tap
methods.description: Simulates a tap on the touchscreen at given coordinates.
